<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915808_theRebbe_726" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915808_theRebbe_726__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Opening with the date of the maamar, 19 Kislev 5738.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B'Siyata Dishmaya.</t>
    <t s="1">19 Kislev 5738*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The redemption of 19 Kislev is connected to the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace," as explained by the Alter Rebbe.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"He redeemed my soul in peace from the battle against me, for many were with me"1,</t>
    <t s="1">And it is known what was said by the Rebbe, the Alter Rebbe, author of the redemption, in his holy letter2</t>
    <t s="2">(regarding the redemption of 19 Kislev),</t>
    <t s="3">When I read in the book of Tehillim the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace,"</t>
    <t s="4">before I began the verse after it,</t>
    <t s="5">I went out in peace from the One of peace,</t>
    <t s="6">that his redemption is connected to the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace."</t>
    <t s="7">And from this it is understood also regarding the redemption of his son and successor, the Rebbe, the Mitteler Rebbe</t>
    <t s="8">(on 10 Kislev),</t>
    <t s="9">that it is connected to the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace"3,</t>
    <t s="10">for this verse is in the monthly portion of Tehillim for the tenth day of the month4.</t>
    <t s="11">[And one can connect this also with the length of the explanation etc. in his discourse beginning "He redeemed my soul in peace"5].</t>
    <t s="12">And also the redemption of 12 and 13 Tammuz of the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="13">their successor</t>
    <t s="14">(of the Alter Rebbe and the Mitteler Rebbe),</t>
    <t s="15">is connected to the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace"6,</t>
    <t s="16">as is also proven from the fact that several of the maamarim of 12 and 13 Tammuz7</t>
    <t s="17">begin with this verse.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The connection of redemption to "peace" is also related to the fact that the redemptions occurred on a third day or in a third month, as peace is associated with the third.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this matter</t>
    <t s="2">[the connection of the redemption to "He redeemed my soul in peace"]</t>
    <t s="3">is also connected to the fact that the redemption of 19 Kislev was on the third day in which "it was good" was repeated8</t>
    <t s="4">[i.e., Tuesday]9</t>
    <t s="5">and in the third month</t>
    <t s="6">(of the winter months)10</t>
    <t s="7">[And also the redemption of 10 Kislev and of 12 Tammuz were on the third,</t>
    <t s="8">the redemption of 10 Kislev – in the third month,</t>
    <t s="9">and the redemption of 12 Tammuz – on the third day in which "it was good" was repeated],</t>
    <t s="10">for the main novelty in the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace" is</t>
    <t s="11">(not so much the matter of redemption,</t>
    <t s="12">but rather)</t>
    <t s="13">that the redemption is in peace11</t>
    <t s="14">and the third12</t>
    <t s="15">is the matter of peace13.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
